records.source: U.S. Naval Observatory, Earth Orientation Department, TAI-UTC table (tai-utc.dat), 1961 to the latest leap second: https://maia.usno.navy.mil/ser7/tai-utc.dat (SHA-256 3524e1ae34d67e858873a89e59983bbc5bd100221da898e796c1b36036a310c3); NASA JPL Navigation and Ancillary Information Facility, NAIF generic leap-second kernel naif0012.tls: https://naif.jpl.nasa.gov/pub/naif/generic_kernels/lsk/naif0012.tls (SHA-256 678e32bdb5a744117a467cd9601cd6b373f0e9bc9bbde1371d5eee39600a039b). Built by tools/envdata/products/tai_utc.py into data/environment/time/tai_utc.bin (SHA-256 6e3a61a1e6b097087dc1669033630364f2ce683114d97a6a84c9f153cfb38146).
records.variant: UTC as defined since 1961-01-01: 1961-1971 offsets with rate terms, integer leap seconds from 1972
records.conditions: TAI - UTC = offset_s + (MJD_UTC - mjd_reference) * rate_s_per_day from jd_utc_start; the 1972+ steps are cross-checked against NAIF DELTET/DELTA_AT at build time.
records.uncertainty: Exact by definition (IERS Bulletin C / BIH); valid until the next announced leap second.

records.source: IERS Earth Orientation Centre, Paris Observatory, EOP (IERS) 20 C04 daily series 1962-now, consistent with ITRF 2020: https://hpiers.obspm.fr/iers/eop/eopc04/eopc04.1962-now (rows through 2026   6  30   0, prefix SHA-256 a26cf3eb29bdcfa6d2f8a31ded0b826cc0eb20ca66805cb93bcf0677710b3bb2). Built by tools/envdata/products/eop_c04.py into data/environment/earth/eop_c04.bin (SHA-256 c6121f2fcd1e369d20b2740b13211f890e57d41ce86b31a11dbf83f261940bce).
records.variant: IERS EOP 20 C04, daily at 0h UTC, 1962-01-01 to 2026-06-30
records.conditions: Polar motion, UT1-UTC, LOD and celestial pole offsets as observed; after the last row the orientation holds its last values with a growing, declared error.
records.uncertainty: Per-row published 1-sigma: 0.02 arcsec (~0.6 m) and 1.5 ms (~0.7 m at the equator) in 1969; ~50 microarcsec and ~20 microseconds today.

records.source: IAU 2006 precession and IAU 2000A nutation (IERS Conventions 2010, chapter 5) evaluated by ERFA eraXys06a (pyerfa 2.0.1.5, from the IAU SOFA library). Built by tools/envdata/products/cip_xys.py into data/environment/earth/cip_xys.bin (SHA-256 0017fb77787f4cea72418f89b759dcb6955b087d29e2ffa3ddca0e329bdde77b).
records.variant: CIP X, Y and CIO locator s, daily at 0h TT, 1960-01-01 to 2051-12-31
records.conditions: Pure IAU model; observed corrections dX, dY come from eop_c04. Interpolated with 8-point Lagrange in the simulation.
records.uncertainty: IAU 2006/2000A model accuracy ~0.2 mas against VLBI before dX/dY; interpolation error tested below 1 microarcsec.
